versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Anything2Explainer.
- Automatically turns any topic into animated explainer videos with TTS voiceover and bilingual (Chinese/English) support.
- Offers a full video creation pipeline: research, script, storyboard, animation rendering, and QC.
- Supports subtitles, chapter progress bars, batch video generation, and technical/educational topics.
- Built on Remotion (React + TypeScript); outputs 1-3 minute videos.
